drhp.business: Kesar Petroproducts manufactures phthalocyanine (CPC) blue crude and its downstream products, Alpha Blue and Beta Blue pigments, in a vertically integrated process where CPC blue crude is the raw material for the pigments. Most of its output is now sold as finished pigments, including Alpha Blue (151), with crude sold separately forming only a small part of sales. Printing inks and paints are its main end markets. It has also started commercial production of technical-grade complex fertilizers made from by-products, used mainly in drip irrigation, with a capacity of 3,600 MTPA, and is commissioning a cogeneration power plant in phases. The company was taken over by the Sharma Group under a BIFR rehabilitation scheme in 2007-08 and acquired CPC blue assets from group company Shreyas Intermediates in 2015. It has sold in about 15 countries.
drhp.oem: Shreyas Intermediates (group company; source of CPC blue assets)
